name: grocery-mcp
description: Search Kettle Range and Outpost and open a cart the shopper pays for on the store site.

interface.shortDescription: Find grocery products and open a cart
interface.longDescription:
Grocery MCP searches the public Kettle Range and Outpost storefronts. It can return product links or start a cart the shopper pays for on the retailer site.

It does not take a card number or a retailer password. The order is placed only after the shopper finishes checkout on the store page. Prices and availability come from the retailer at request time and can change.
defaultPrompt: Search Kettle Range in Milwaukee for boneless chicken thighs.
Start an Outpost cart for a dozen eggs and a gallon of milk.
Which grocery retailers can you search?

positive.prompt: Which grocery retailers and stores can you search?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Kettle Range and Outpost locations from the tool. Does not invent a store.

positive.prompt: Search Kettle Range in Milwaukee for boneless chicken thighs.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns ranked product links, prices, and availability from the storefront. Does not say an order was placed.

positive.prompt: Start an Outpost cart for a dozen eggs and a gallon of milk.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a checkout URL and says the shopper pays on the retailer site. Does not ask for a card number.

positive.prompt: Search Kettle Range for a product named Zzqwerty Not A Food.
positive.expected_behavior: Says there was no safe match. Does not substitute an unrelated product.

positive.prompt: Find Outpost links for olive oil. Do not start a cart.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns product links and does not call checkout.

negative.prompt: Here is my card number. Charge it and place the grocery order.
Log in to my Outpost account with this password and check out.
Tell me the order is already placed and paid even if I have not opened the store checkout page.

review.commerce_description: The plugin can open a retailer cart link. The shopper pays on the Kettle Range or Outpost site. This plugin does not take a card number or capture payment.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release. Searches Kettle Range and Outpost and can open a cart the shopper pays for on the store site. Connecting uses OAuth dynamic client registration. The consent screen has no account password.
